subject: Texas Finance Festival - regrets
body:
Vince,

Greetings.

Just wanted to drop a line expressing regret for my missing your Texas Finance Festival keynote address. I would have enjoyed hearing your views and catching up on things.

Regrettably, however, it appears I will be unable to attend this year's TFF. I look forward to seeing you again at next month's EPRM 2001.

Best,
Ehud
